entries.title: Europa Universalis

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with modern compatibility fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2000 grand-strategy game.

primary.why: The original Europa Universalis is a Windows PC release, so Windows PC is both the complete and highest-fidelity sourced route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC storefront release or preserved retail copy. Later sequels are separate entries rather than replacements for the original.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The sourced public release route is Windows PC only.

entries.remaster_caveats: The later numbered games are sequels, not remasters of the original.

entries.title: Europa Universalis II
entries.definitive_edition: Europa Universalis II on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with modern compatibility fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2001 grand-strategy game.

primary.why: Windows PC is the original and most accessible route for Europa Universalis II, with the clearest current compatibility and storefront trail. The Mac OS port is valid historically, but it is not the best current play route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Europa Universalis II on Windows PC through the available PC storefront or preserved retail release.

all_releases.reason: primary: original and best current compatibility/capture route.
skip: valid historical route, but Windows PC remains the clearer current play path.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the original and most practical route; the Mac port adds no sourced exclusive content.

entries.remaster_caveats: For the Glory is a later Europa Universalis II-derived standalone and is listed separately.

entries.title: Europa Universalis III
entries.definitive_edition: Europa Universalis III Chronicles on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release; no emulation is needed, though compatibility fixes may help on modern systems.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for the Clausewitz-era game.

primary.why: Europa Universalis III Chronicles on Windows PC bundles the base game and the major expansions, making it the cleanest complete route. The Mac port is valid, but Windows PC has the clearest current compatibility, capture, and storefront support.
primary.how_to_play: Play Europa Universalis III Chronicles on Windows PC through Steam or GOG to get the complete expansion bundle.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows release, with Chronicles bundling the base game and all four major expansions.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete route and preferred compatibility/capture platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Historic Mac OS X port, with later Mac Chronicles availability.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid Mac route, but Windows PC remains the cleaner complete/capture recommendation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows Chronicles route is both the complete expansion bundle and the best current recommendation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Napoleon's Ambition, In Nomine, Heir to the Throne, and Divine Wind are expansions bundled by Chronicles, not separate mainline entries.

entries.title: Europa Universalis: Rome
entries.definitive_edition: Europa Universalis: Rome Gold on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release; no emulation is needed, though compatibility fixes may help on modern systems.

primary.why: The Windows PC Gold route includes the Vae Victis expansion and is the clearest complete way to play Europa Universalis: Rome. The Mac port is valid historically, but Windows PC remains the stronger current compatibility and capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Europa Universalis: Rome Gold on Windows PC through Steam or GOG for the base game plus Vae Victis.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows PC release, with Gold Edition including Vae Victis.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete and current storefront route.

all_releases.fidelity: Historic Mac OS X port, with a later Mac Gold Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid Mac route, but Windows PC remains the preferred complete/capture recommendation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Gold Edition on Windows PC is both the complete package and the strongest current route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Vae Victis is expansion content bundled in the Gold Edition, not a separate mainline entry. Imperator: Rome is a spiritual successor and should be listed separately when added.

entries.title: For the Glory: A Europa Universalis Game
entries.definitive_edition: For the Glory: A Europa Universalis Game on Windows PC, updated to 1.3

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: For the Glory is a Windows PC Europa Universalis II-derived standalone, and PC is the only sourced release route. The later 1.3 update adds new systems, scenarios, UI improvements, and expanded timeline support to the same PC game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version through Steam or GOG and update to the current 1.3 branch where available.

all_releases.fidelity: Standalone Windows PC release based on Europa Universalis II, with a later 1.3 update path.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and complete current route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The sourced public release route is Windows PC only.

entries.remaster_caveats: For the Glory is a standalone Europa Universalis II-derived game, not a DLC pack for Europa Universalis II.

entries.title: Europa Universalis IV
entries.definitive_edition: Europa Universalis IV on Windows PC with current DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod/DLC support.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original and strongest Europa Universalis IV route, with the full DLC library, mod support, keyboard-and-mouse controls, and the best capture/settings flexibility. macOS and Linux are valid native routes, but Windows PC is the safest complete recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Epic, Microsoft Store, or GOG, and add the DLC/Ultimate Bundle content you want for the complete legacy EU4 path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the full DLC/mod route and current storefront support.
all_releases.reason: primary: original, most complete, and best-supported route.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC family has the same content base, while Windows PC is the strongest practical capture/support route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Europa Universalis IV's expansions, immersion packs, and content packs are DLC, not separate game entries. Europa Universalis V is a separate sequel.

entries.title: Europa Universalis V
entries.definitive_edition: Europa Universalis V on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Europa Universalis V is currently sourced as a Windows PC release, making Windows PC the only and best public play route. It is also the newest mainline game in the series, but Europa Universalis IV remains a separate legacy entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play Europa Universalis V on Windows PC through Steam and keep it updated through the current patch path.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and current mainline route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The sourced public release route is Windows PC only.

entries.remaster_caveats: Europa Universalis V is a sequel to Europa Universalis IV, not a remaster or replacement of earlier entries.
